answer: Identity-issuance bonds priced by auction: each epoch the right to register a new identity sells in a uniform-price auction and every winning bid burns. An honest agent buys one bond and earns it back mining; a sybil farm must outbid the whole market for every clone, so attacker cost scales with its own volume while the burn shrinks the pool it mines. Bond receipts form an onyx audit trail, every resale carries an echo of the first holder, and a flagged identity is ferrous-sealed, bonded until it repays what it burned.
